newsitem.title: UK: UK Independent on Sunday editor asked to step down.
newsitem.headline: UK Independent on Sunday editor asked to step down.

text.p: Peter Wilby has been asked to step down as the editor of Britain's Independent on Sunday newspaper, but may stay on in another capacity, a spokesman for the paper said on Tuesday.
"A successor will be appointed in due course," he told Reuters.
A source close to the company said the mood at the paper, part of Mirror Group Newspapers Plc, was "generally depressed".
Wilby is likely to be replaced by Rosie Boycott, the editor of magazine British Esquire, the source added. Official confirmation is expected after a board meeting next Thursday.
"That's the word," the source said. "They want to give the paper a younger image."
Boycott would be the newspaper's fourth editor since the paper was launched about seven years ago.
